required_facts.fact: One of the first videos I ever published on YouTube was about getting a data science job.
I presented the algorithm that you can follow to get hired in data science.
Many things have changed since then, but the algorithm that I described still works.
In this article I take that algorithm and update it for AI Engineering.
The updates are minimal and you can use this algorithm for any other engineering job.
